# Emad Alhamou

> Personal site of Emad Alhamou, a Syrian-German founder and product builder based in Germany. He builds Nadhif, TakeCar, Shfli, and Arab Solutions: products for Mac maintenance and security, mobility, marketplaces, and AI-powered customer support in emerging markets. The site is in Arabic, English and German (picked from the browser language, switchable in the footer).

## Main page

- [hamou.de](https://hamou.de/): About Emad, his companies, open-source tools, articles, experience, and contact.

## Products

- [TakeCar](https://takecarapp.com): Syrian ride-sharing and mobility app. Drivers sell the empty seats of trips they already plan, passengers travel between governorates for less, and the app also covers city rides and delivery. Built by the Alhamou team.
- [Arab Solutions](https://omysyria.com/ar): AI customer support platform that brings knowledge and channels into one place.
- [Shfli](https://www.shfli.com/?section=items): Platform for buying, selling, and auctions.
- [Nadhif](https://nadhif.hamou.de/): Mac cleaner with developer tools and a vulnerability scanner that helps protect websites and servers from hackers, built by the Alhamou team (in development since September 2026).

## Articles

Articles are static pages in English, German and Arabic (where a translation exists). Add index.md to an article URL for a plain Markdown copy. All English articles in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://hamou.de/llms-full.txt). The articles about the open-source tools are listed under Open source below.

- [Shfli: a Syrian online marketplace for cars, real estate, auctions, bazaars and jobs](https://hamou.de/articles/shfli/index.md): Shfli is a Syrian online marketplace and app for buying and selling cars, real estate and more, with live auctions, bazaars and jobs. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/shfli/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/shfli/index.md).
- [Arab Solutions: Arabic-first AI customer support that answers from your own knowledge](https://hamou.de/articles/arab-solutions/index.md): Arab Solutions (O My Syria) is an Arabic-first AI customer support platform: an assistant that answers from your own documents, on your website and WhatsApp. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/arab-solutions/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/arab-solutions/index.md).
- [TakeCar: a Syrian app for ride sharing between cities, city rides and delivery](https://hamou.de/articles/takecar/index.md): TakeCar is a Syrian app for shared rides between cities: drivers sell the empty seats of trips they already plan, passengers travel for less. It also covers city rides and delivery. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/takecar/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/takecar/index.md).
- [Nadhif: clean your Mac with developer tools and protect your website and server from hackers](https://hamou.de/articles/nadhif/index.md): Nadhif is a Mac cleaner with developer tools that also tests your websites and servers for vulnerabilities, so you can fix weak spots before hackers find them. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/nadhif/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/nadhif/index.md).
<!-- articles:end -->

## Open source

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/Alhamou): OpenBlock, RemoteDesk, pinFiy, closeAll, SafeShare, TopMovies, moveMouse, Haki.
<!-- tools:start -->
- [OpenBlock: an open-source ad blocker for Safari on Mac, with no tracking](https://hamou.de/articles/openblock/index.md): OpenBlock is an open-source ad blocker for Safari on macOS. It turns real filter lists into Safari's native content blockers and has no tracking. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/openblock/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/openblock/index.md).
- [RemoteDesk: an open-source Mac-to-Mac remote desktop for your local network](https://hamou.de/articles/remotedesk/index.md): RemoteDesk is an open-source Mac-to-Mac remote desktop for local networks. It streams the screen with hardware H.264 and forwards input. For trusted networks only. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/remotedesk/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/remotedesk/index.md).
- [pinFiy: colored sticky notes for the Mac, with a small pin in the menu bar](https://hamou.de/articles/pinfiy/index.md): pinFiy is an open-source macOS sticky notes app. Each note is its own window, Arabic runs right to left, and there is no account, cloud sync or network access. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/pinfiy/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/pinfiy/index.md).
- [closeAll: force-quit every Dock app from one menu-bar button on Mac](https://hamou.de/articles/closeall/index.md): closeAll is an open-source macOS menu-bar app that force-quits every normal Dock app at once, after you review the list. Unsaved work in those apps is lost. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/closeall/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/closeall/index.md).
- [SafeShare: hide private apps while you share your Mac screen in Teams, Zoom or Meet](https://hamou.de/articles/safeshare/index.md): SafeShare is an open-source macOS app that hides private apps and windows when you share your screen in Teams, Zoom or Google Meet, using a Safe View window. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/safeshare/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/safeshare/index.md).
- [TopMovies: a native Mac app to discover movies and TV series, with a local library](https://hamou.de/articles/topmovies/index.md): TopMovies is an open-source native macOS app for discovering movies and TV series, with curated feeds, filters, a local library and an offline demo mode. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/topmovies/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/topmovies/index.md).
- [moveMouse: a Mac menu-bar app that helps keep your RDP connection from dropping](https://hamou.de/articles/movemouse/index.md): moveMouse is an open-source macOS menu-bar app that moves the pointer on a schedule and prevents idle sleep, so a remote desktop (RDP) connection is less likely to drop. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/movemouse/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/movemouse/index.md).
- [Haki (حكي): push-to-talk dictation for the Mac menu bar, tuned for Arabic](https://hamou.de/articles/haki/index.md): Haki is an open-source macOS menu-bar dictation app. Hold Option+Space, speak Arabic, English, German or French, release, and the text is pasted at your cursor. Also in [Deutsch](https://hamou.de/de/articles/haki/index.md) and [العربية](https://hamou.de/ar/articles/haki/index.md).
<!-- tools:end -->
